$comment: English catalogue — used for exports, supplier correspondence and English-speaking staff.

Patient.Title: Patient
Patient.AlertExpiryNotice: With no expiry date the alert is permanent. "Pregnant, third trimester" is only true for three months.
Patient.AlertInformationNotice: Information shown when the file is opened, without interrupting the work.
Patient.AlertWarningNotice: Warning highlighted when the file is opened.
Patient.AlertCriticalNotice: A critical alert blocks registration until it is acknowledged: it interrupts the operator.
Patient.ConfirmCriticalAlert: Create a critical alert? It will interrupt the registration of every order for this patient until acknowledged. An alert that interrupts everybody ends up ignored.
Patient.OptOutOfSecondaryUse: Patient objects to any use of their data beyond their care
Patient.OptOutExplanation: Loi no. 08-09 art. 9: the patient may object to their data being used for anything other than their care. The objection excludes the record from statistics and from any research.
Patient.PregnancyExplanation: A declared pregnancy switches the reference intervals to gestational values and blocks certain analyses.
Patient.InterferenceExplanation: Current treatment is a frequent cause of an unexpected result; recording it avoids a needless repeat.
Patient.PhoneNormalisedNotice: The number is stored in international format (+212…) — the format the SMS gateway requires to notify the patient.
Patient.MergeDirection: Record {0} will be redirected to {1}. Searches follow the pointer.
Patient.MergeExplanation: The merged record is not deleted: it remains the actor on its own audit entries and may be referenced by an issued invoice. It simply stops appearing in searches.
Patient.MergeNeedsTwoFiles: A merge needs two records: refine the search so the record to keep appears.
Patient.ConfirmMerge: Merge record {0} into {1}? The operation is logged and cannot be undone from the application.
Patient.DuplicateExplanation: A duplicate record splits one patient's history across two files. The next clinician then loses the previous-result column, which is what makes a delta check mean anything.
Patient.DuplicateOverrideReason: Reason: why is this a different person?
Patient.ConfirmCreateDuplicate: Create a second record despite {0} match(es)? The reason you gave will be kept in the audit trail.
Patient.ConfirmAnonymize: Anonymise the record for {0} ({1})? Direct identifiers will be cleared; the clinical history and the billing trail are kept.
Patient.AnonymizeJustificationPrompt: Reason for anonymising record {0} (patient request, CNDP decision…):
Patient.OverrideRetentionQuestion: Anonymise even though the retention obligation is still running?
Patient.PossibleDuplicateNotice: Possible duplicate file(s): {0} found — {1}. Check before saving: two files for one person split their history.

Coverage.Title: Coverage
Coverage.NoPayersConfigured: No payer is configured, so a coverage cannot be attached.
Coverage.PricedOnLabPriceList: priced on the laboratory's price list
Coverage.PricingNotice: The rate applies to the reimbursement base, not to the price charged: anything above the reference tariff stays with the patient.
Coverage.ReferenceTariff: Priced on the national reference tariff
Coverage.PayerTariffNotice: The rates shipped with the installation are starting points: confirm them against the convention in force before billing AMO.
Coverage.AmoTariffNotice: An AMO scheme settles on the national reference tariff by law; this is not the laboratory's choice.
Coverage.PayerRateNotice: The rate applies to the reimbursement base (coefficient × letter-key value), not to the charged price. Enter 70 for 70 %.

Order.Title: Order
Order.InpeNotice: Without an INPE, a third-party claim carrying this prescriber's prescription cannot be submitted.
Order.CriticalPhoneNotice: A critical result has to be communicated to a named person, on a number somebody recorded.
Order.DeliveryContactNotice: The chosen delivery method needs an e-mail address, a mobile number or a fax on file.
Order.AddAnalysesNotice: Added analyses are priced against the order's coverage, not the patient's current one: the addition belongs to the episode of care opened at the counter. A tube already drawn for the same container is reused.
Order.AmendmentNotice: The reason is kept in the audit log: ISO 15189 requires every alteration to a request to be traceable to who made it and why.
Order.CoverageNotEditable: coverage cannot be changed after registration (credit note, then a new invoice)
Order.CancelledItemNeedsCreditNote: {0} cancelled. The order is invoiced, so the money is put right by a credit note.
Order.RepeatAnalysisPrompt: Reason for repeating {0} (run {1}): suspect value, dilution, rejected control run…
Order.RepeatRecorded: {0} sent back to the bench — run {1}
Order.ConfirmCancelOrder: Cancel order {0} ({1} analysis(es), {2} tube(s))? The tubes still held will be discarded.
Order.CancelledNeedsCreditNote: Order cancelled. Invoice {0} is still owed: issue a credit note.

Sample.Title: Sample
Sample.ReprintReasonPrompt: Reason for reprinting the label (damaged, illegible, additional tube…)
Sample.OnlyPastRetention: Only tubes past their retention period
Sample.AliquotCreated: Aliquot created. Label the tube with barcode {0}.
Sample.AliquotNotice: The aliquot gets its own barcode: traceability follows the fraction, which does not end up in the same place as the parent tube.
Sample.KeepUntilNotice: After this date the tube is listed as dischargeable. Leave unchecked for storage with no fixed end.
Sample.ConfirmDiscard: Discard tube {0} ({1})? No analysis can be repeated on this sample afterwards.
Sample.ConfirmPurge: Discard the {0} tubes past their retention period?
Sample.PurgePrompt: Reason for discarding these {0} tubes. It is recorded against each one.
Sample.LabelsAsPdf: {0} label(s) as a PDF: no label printer is configured on this workstation. Check the scale before printing.

Collection.ConfirmFasting: to be confirmed with the patient
Collection.FastingQuestion: Does the patient declare having fasted for at least {0} hours?

Validation.ReadBackPrompt: Ask the recipient to repeat the value back, and enter what they said.
Validation.UnvalidatePrompt: Reason for unvalidating {0} result(s). The value is kept: it is the release that is withdrawn, and a revision is recorded on the file.

Report.Title: Report
Report.RegisterSearchPlaceholder: Accession number, patient name or patient record number
Report.ReprintLogged: Reprint of {0} v{1} — the access is logged.
Report.ChannelNotice: The channel offered is the one the prescriber asked for.
Report.CounterChannelNotice: Handed over at the counter: the delivery is complete the moment it happens.
Report.EmailChannelNotice: Sent by e-mail: the address is required, and the delivery stays "sent" until confirmed.
Report.SmsChannelNotice: Download link by SMS: the mobile number is required; the link expires after thirty days.
Report.FaxChannelNotice: Sent by fax: the number is required.
Report.CourierChannelNotice: Delivered by courier: name the bearer, they are the one holding the document.
Report.InterfaceChannelNotice: Pushed to the prescriber's software over the integration interface.
Report.RecipientIdentifierNotice: E-mail, mobile or fax number depending on the channel. It is the record of where the document went.
Report.BearerNotice: The bearer is the person physically taking the document: "somebody came for it" is not a record.
Report.ThirdPartyConsentNotice: Release to a third party needs the patient's written consent on file (loi 08-09). Give the reference of the recorded consent.
Report.AmendmentKindNotice: The kind is printed on the amended report: the reader has to know what changed.
Report.AmendsVersion: amends version {0} — the new version will be numbered {1}
Report.AlreadyDeliveredNotice: This version was delivered on {0}: the recipient holds a document this one contradicts.
Report.NotYetDeliveredNotice: No delivery is recorded for this version, but it may have been printed and taken away.
Report.ResultCorrectionNotice: A result value was corrected. This is the amendment that most needs explaining: the clinician may have acted on the old one.
Report.AdditionNotice: An analysis was added to an order already reported.
Report.CommentRevisionNotice: The comment or conclusion was revised; the results are unchanged.
Report.IdentityCorrectionNotice: The patient's identity was corrected. If the earlier report went to the wrong recipient, that is a notifiable data breach rather than a clerical fix.
Report.RetractionNotice: The report is withdrawn in full, for example after a proven sample mix-up.
Report.ConfirmIdentityAmendment: Confirm this amendment? If the earlier report was handed to anyone other than the patient, the CNDP must be informed.
Report.AmendmentReasonNotice: The reason is printed on the amended report. An amended document that does not say what it amends leaves the clinician with two versions and no way to choose.
Report.ConclusionNotice: Optional: the biologist's interpretive comment, printed at the end of the report.
Report.AmendmentSupersedesNotice: The previous version is retained and marked superseded: it is already in a clinician's hands and may have been acted on.
Report.AccreditedNote: Analyses performed within the ISO 15189 accreditation scope
Report.SubcontractedNote: Analysis performed by a partner laboratory
Report.ReservationNote: Result obtained on a sample accepted with reservation
Report.ConfidentialityNote: Confidential — for the patient and the prescribing physician
Report.CriticalCommunicated: Critical result — communicated to the prescriber

Billing.AmountInWords: This invoice is settled at the sum of
Billing.ConfirmIssue: Issue an invoice for {0} order(s), totalling {1}? An issued invoice cannot be changed.
Billing.CreditNoteReasonPrompt: Reason for the credit note against invoice {0}. An issued invoice is not cancelled: a credit note is the only correction available.
Billing.NoClaimableInvoices: No submittable invoice in the selection.
Billing.ClaimOutcomeForCount: Response to record against {0} submitted invoice(s).
Billing.NoSubmittedClaims: None of the selected invoices has been submitted to a third-party payer.
Billing.PayerNotCovered: No cover — payable by the patient
Billing.DiscountNotice: The discount is spread across the lines pro rata and stays on the invoice with its reason. An issued invoice can no longer be altered.

Claim.MixedPayerSelection: {0} invoice(s) across {1} different payers: a batch concerns one payer only.
Claim.BatchSummaryChasing: {0} batch(es) — {1} still to recover · {2} unanswered and due a chase

Payment.Title: Payment
Payment.VarianceRequiresExplanation: A variance above {0} MAD must be explained before closing.
Payment.ConfirmClose: Close the till with {0} counted, a variance of {1}?
Payment.NoRefundablePayment: No settled payment on this invoice can be refunded.
Payment.NoBounceablePayment: No settled cheque or bill of exchange on this invoice can be marked as returned.
Payment.BouncePrompt: Reason {0} ({1}) was returned unpaid — the reason the bank gave:
Payment.WithdrawalAmountPrompt: Amount taken from the till and banked (MAD):
Payment.WithdrawalReasonPrompt: Reason for withdrawing {0} MAD (banking, cash transfer…):

Quality.Title: Quality
Quality.EstablishLimitsPrompt: Over how many days of history should the laboratory mean and SD be computed? At least {0} accepted points are needed.
Quality.CorrectiveActionPrompt: Describe the corrective action taken. A rejected control with no corrective action is an audit finding.
Quality.OpenNonConformityQuestion: Open a non-conformity record for this rejection?
Quality.NoRulesWarning: No rule active: the control will record points and never reject a run, which looks like a control that is passing.
Quality.RuleSelectionExplanation: The rule set is the analytical control strategy. Too few rules let a systematic error through; too many on an imprecise method multiply false rejections, and the bench then learns to work around them.
Quality.AssignedLimitsNotice: The mean and SD from the insert are the starting limits. Without them the target accepts values but can compute no Z-score, so no rule can evaluate.
Quality.TargetNotice: The target is the record the whole module depends on: without one, the internal quality-control entry sheet stays permanently empty.
Quality.TargetLifecycleNotice: The laboratory's own limits replace the supplier's once enough accepted points exist (the "establish laboratory limits" button).
Quality.MaterialStabilityNotice: Stability after opening makes the material unusable past that period, even before the printed expiry date.
Quality.NeedInstrumentFirst: Create a piece of equipment first.
Quality.NeedParameterFirst: No analysis parameter is available in the catalogue.

NonConformity.Title: Non-conformity
NonConformity.EvidencePrompt: What evidence shows the action was actually carried out?
NonConformity.ConfirmDismiss: Dismiss non-conformity {0}? It will be recorded as an unfounded report and will not count among the period's non-conformities.
NonConformity.DismissPrompt: Justification: why is report {0} not a non-conformity?

Inventory.Title: Inventory
Inventory.ReceivedQuarantined: The lot is recorded as quarantined: it must be released, with evidence of verification, before it can be used on a patient sample.
Inventory.IssueQuantityPrompt: Quantity to issue for {0} (in {1}). Usable stock: {2}. Lots are consumed first-expiry-first-out.
Inventory.ReleaseEvidencePrompt: Evidence of verification for lot {0}: which check showed that this lot performs acceptably?
Inventory.RecallAffectedResults: {0} patient result(s) were produced with lot {1}. Those reports must be reviewed.
Inventory.RecallNoResults: No patient result was produced with this lot.
Inventory.WriteOffPrompt: Reason for writing off lot {0} ({1} remaining):
Inventory.ClearRejectionPrompt: Reason for withdrawing the rejection of lot {0}. The lot returns to quarantine: the acceptance check is still owed.
Inventory.ReorderNotice: The reorder point must sit at or above the safety stock, otherwise the alert fires when the laboratory is already below the level it set itself.
Inventory.CriticalNotice: A stock-out on a critical item stops an analysis being offered, which has to be declared to prescribers.
Inventory.SupplierEvaluationNotice: ISO 15189 §4.6: approving a supplier rests on evaluating them. An evaluation older than twelve months is flagged as due again.

Equipment.Title: Equipment
Equipment.OnlyDue: Show only overdue and out-of-service equipment
Equipment.PostCheckExplanation: Untick if the post-intervention check did not pass: the equipment is then not returned to service.
Equipment.CalibrationOverdueWarning: Calibration overdue: no patient result may be produced on this equipment.
Equipment.ReturnToServiceNotice: Return to service is refused while a calibration is overdue; record the calibration first.
Equipment.DecommissionNotice: Decommissioning is final: the equipment leaves the register and can no longer produce a result.
Equipment.IntervalNotice: A missing interval silently disarms the matching overdue indicator — and, for an analyser, the control that forbids producing a patient result on a lapsed calibration.
Equipment.CalibrationIntervalNotice: The calibration interval is mandatory for an analyser: it is what makes the control forbidding a result on a lapsed calibration able to fire at all.
Equipment.LastDatesNotice: Last-intervention dates normally advance by recording an intervention. They are editable here so the paper equipment file can be carried over at commissioning: without them every instrument would read as overdue on day one.

Calibration.CalibratorLotRequiredNotice: The calibrator lot is mandatory: it is the link to the reference material without which the calibration is not traceable.

Interface.ReplayConfirm: Re-import this transmission? The analyser's values will be stored in the patient file.
Interface.ReplayNothing: Re-import complete, no value stored: read the row's issues.
Interface.ReplayNotPossible: This row cannot be re-imported: only failed, partial or held transmissions can be.
Interface.PurgeLogScope: {0} frame(s) older than {1} will be deleted. {2} frame(s) are being kept because they are still replayable.
Interface.PurgeLogNothing: No frame is older than the {0}-day retention period.
Interface.PurgeLogPrompt: Reason for the purge. It is recorded with your name, the cutoff date and the number of frames deleted.
Interface.PurgeLogRetained: {0} frame(s) kept despite their age: they are still replayable. Deal with them from the log.
Interface.RouteControls: Route controls to the QC module
Interface.MappingNotice: This table is the interface's whole safety story: an unknown code is a lost result, and a mis-mapped one puts a potassium value in a sodium field. The conversion factor is the most dangerous number on this screen — a wrong one is a hundredfold error on a report.
Interface.SerialNotice: RS-232 serial link: give the port and the frame settings exactly as the analyser expects them.
Interface.TcpNotice: TCP link: either the LIS connects to the analyser, or it listens and the analyser connects. Only one workstation may listen on a given port.
Interface.FileDropNotice: The analyser writes files to a directory the LIS watches. Processed files are moved, not deleted.
Interface.ListenNotice: In listening mode the host is left empty: the analyser opens the connection.
Interface.ProcessedNotice: Imported files are moved here, so an empty inbound directory means "nothing waiting".
Interface.EncodingNotice: ISO-8859-1 suits the great majority of analysers. A wrong encoding does not prevent connection: it silently corrupts accented characters and comments.
Interface.AutoAcceptNotice: Without auto-acceptance every transmission is held in the log until a technician accepts it. With it, the analyser's values go straight into the patient file with nobody looking — turn it on only once the mapping table has been verified.
Interface.ConfirmAutoAccept: Enable auto-acceptance? The analyser's results will be stored in the patient file without being reviewed first.
Interface.EnabledNotice: An enabled link is only driven by the workstation designated as the instrument host.
Interface.HostNotThisWorkstation: This workstation does not drive the analysers: links are configurable here, but they run on the host workstation.
Interface.HostRunning: Instrument host running — {0} link(s) in service, {1} in fault.
Interface.ServiceAccountMissing: The instrument host will not start: the service account "{0}" does not exist. Create it in Administration → Users.
Interface.SavedTakesEffect: Saved. The host picks the change up within {0} seconds.

Catalog.CodeSetOnce: The code is entered once and cannot be changed afterwards.
Catalog.CodeImmutableNotice: The code cannot be changed: analysers, worklists and every stored result refer to it.
Catalog.TurnaroundNotice: The promised turnaround runs from sample reception, not from registration of the order.
Catalog.PartialEditNotice: Fields the list does not carry open empty: fill them only if you mean to replace them.
Catalog.ValueTypeNotice: The value type governs which fields mean anything; the others are disabled.
Catalog.ValueTypeFrozenNotice: Type frozen: {0} stored result(s). Reading them as another type would make the history unreadable.
Catalog.LimitsNotice: The limits nest: technical limits outside, measuring range inside. Outside the technical limits entry is refused; outside the measuring range the result must be reported censored or re-run on a dilution.
Catalog.DeltaNotice: A delta check with no window compares against a result of any age: it then fires on everything, and the technician learns to ignore it — which disables the one check that catches a tube swap.
Catalog.FormulaNotice: Refer to the analysis's other parameters in square brackets, e.g. [CHOL] - [HDL] - [TG]/5. An unknown code raises nothing at the bench: the calculation simply stays empty.
Catalog.PrintedIntervalNotice: Use when the numeric bounds do not tell the whole story: "< 5.7 % (normal) / 5.7–6.4 % (pre-diabetes)".
Catalog.InstrumentRangeNotice: A method-dependent interval applies only to results produced on that analyser.
Catalog.SpecificityNotice: Specificity {0}: where intervals compete, the most specific wins.
Catalog.RangeRevisionNotice: Changing the limits of an interval already in force and used opens a revision instead of rewriting it: a result keeps the interval it was interpreted against.
Catalog.RangeSuperseded: Interval revised: the previous one has been closed and remains on file.
Catalog.ReviewNotice: ISO 15189 §5.5.2 requires intervals to be reviewed periodically. "Reviewed, unchanged" is a review outcome in its own right.
Catalog.NoCurrentTariff: No tariff in force for this payer.
Catalog.TariffComputedNotice: Reimbursement base {0} — excess borne by the patient {1}.
Catalog.TariffVersioningNotice: A tariff is not edited: this entry creates a new version and closes the previous one the day before. An issued invoice must reprint with the price it charged.
Catalog.TariffNotice: Select an analysis on the Analyses tab to see and revise its tariffs.
Catalog.VatNotice: Medical biology acts are exempt from VAT in Morocco. The rate applies only to non-exempt items.
Catalog.ItemizeNotice: Third-party payment requires each act to appear with its own code: leave itemisation on for a reimbursable panel.
Catalog.ReflexNotice: A reflex rule adds a confirmatory analysis automatically from a result. A rule whose condition can never be met appears configured and does nothing.
Catalog.ReflexConditionNotice: The condition governs which fields are needed.
Catalog.ReflexGreaterNotice: The rule fires above the threshold.
Catalog.ReflexLessNotice: The rule fires below the threshold.
Catalog.ReflexBetweenNotice: The rule fires between the two thresholds, bounds included.
Catalog.ReflexOutsideNotice: The rule fires outside the interval defined by the two thresholds.
Catalog.ReflexCodedNotice: The rule fires on an exact coded answer, which must be one of the parameter's allowed answers.
Catalog.ReflexBillingNotice: A reflex act added silently and charged to a patient who never asked for it is a complaint the laboratory cannot answer: billing is an explicit choice.
Catalog.ReflexAutomaticNotice: Without automatic addition, the biologist confirms the proposal before the analysis joins the order.
Catalog.AccreditationScopeNotice: The ISO 15189 accreditation scope is declared per department: it decides the statement printed on the report.
Catalog.PatientInstructionsNotice: For material the patient collects: urine, stool, 24-hour collections.
Catalog.DrawOrderNotice: The order of draw prevents additive carry-over between tubes: it is a real source of pre-analytical error, and the collection worklist follows it.
Catalog.ConversionNotice: The factor and the SI unit go together: either alone describes a conversion the report cannot perform.
Catalog.NomenclatureInUseNotice: Entry used by {0} record(s): it cannot be deactivated while they refer to it.

Consent.Title: Consent
Consent.WrittenRequiredNotice: This purpose requires written consent; a verbal agreement is not enough.
Consent.MinorSignedByGuardian: Patient is a minor: consent is given by the legal guardian.
Consent.WrittenEvidenceNotice: Genetic testing, HIV serology and research use require written consent. Without it, registering those analyses is refused.

ConsentPurpose.Diagnostic: Prescribed analyses and processing of the file

Admin.MustChangePassword: Must change password at next sign-in
Admin.DepartmentsHint: Department codes separated by commas. Leaving it empty authorises validation for every department, which is only appropriate for the responsible biologist.
Admin.NoDeleteExplanation: An account is never deleted: it is the actor on every audit entry and the signatory of released reports. A departing member of staff is withdrawn by deactivation.
Admin.BuiltInRoleNotice: Role shipped with the product: its permissions can be changed, but it cannot be renamed or deactivated.
Admin.BiologistRequirementNotice: Loi no. 12-01: biological validation requires a valid registration number with the Ordre.
Admin.PhysicianRequirementNotice: The Ordre registration number is mandatory for a prescribing physician.
Admin.OrderNumberMissingNotice: Ordre registration number missing: this biologist will not be able to validate a result.
Admin.QualificationExpiredNotice: Authorisation expired on {0}: this biologist can no longer validate a result.
Admin.LockedOutNotice: Account locked until {0} after repeated failed attempts.
Admin.PasswordExpiredNotice: Password unchanged for {0} day(s): beyond the period set by the security procedure.
Admin.PasswordNeverChangedNotice: This password has never been changed by its holder: it is still the one the administrator typed.
Admin.UserCreatedMustChangePassword: Account {0} has been created. Its holder must change the password at first sign-in.
Admin.ResetPasswordPrompt: New temporary password for {0}. Pass it on in person: its holder must change it at next sign-in.
Admin.PasswordResetMustChange: The password for {0} has been reset. It must be changed at next sign-in.
Admin.NewRoleCodePrompt: Code for the new role (upper case, no spaces):
Admin.NewRoleNamePrompt: French name of the new role:
Admin.RoleCreatedNoPermissions: The role has been created with no permissions at all. Grant its permissions in the tree, then save.
Admin.RoleGrantsBiologicalValidation: This role grants biological validation, which loi no. 12-01 reserves to a biologist registered with the Ordre.
Admin.RoleGrantsUserManagement: This role grants user management, and therefore control of every permission.
Admin.ConfirmPermissionChange: Role {0}: {1} permission(s) added, {2} removed. The change applies immediately to {3} active user(s). Confirm?
Admin.SequenceFormatPrompt: Format for the "{0}" series. Available tokens: {SITE}, {YEAR}, {YY}, {MM}, {SEQ:n} where n is the number of digits.
Admin.CloseSequencePrompt: Reason for closing the "{0}" series (year-end close…):
Admin.ReopenSequencePrompt: Reason for reopening the "{0}" series: it will allow a document to be numbered into a period whose accounts may already be filed.
Admin.SequenceFormatNotice: The format is editable only while no number has been allocated. After that it is frozen: the DGI requires an unbroken chronological series, and two formats in one series cannot be reconciled.
Admin.SettingsNotice: These settings are held in the database, so they are the same on every workstation. A sensitive setting's value is not shown here.
Admin.ConfirmDeactivateRole: Deactivate role {0}? It immediately stops granting its permissions to {1} active user(s).
Admin.MasterDataComplete: Reference data complete: every screen is usable.
Admin.MasterDataIncomplete: Screens still unusable for want of reference data

Audit.Truncated: More than {0} rows: the list is truncated. Narrow the period or the filters before drawing a conclusion.

Site.Title: Site
Site.InvoicingReady: Invoicing available: the mandatory legal particulars are complete.
Site.ConfigurationComplete: Configuration complete: invoicing and report release are now unblocked.

Login.Subtitle: Medical biology laboratory information system

Message.ReasonRequiredPrompt: State the reason for this operation. It is kept in the audit trail.
Message.ConcurrencyConflict: Another workstation changed this record after you opened it. Reload it and redo your entry.
Message.ConnectionLost: The database connection was lost. Check the network and try again.
Message.UnexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred. The incident has been logged.
Message.PermissionDenied: You are not permitted to perform this operation.
Message.SessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

Qc.Rule_2_2s: 2₂ₛ — two consecutive points beyond the same ±2 SD limit
Qc.Rule_R_4s: R₄ₛ — range greater than 4 SD within the same run
Qc.Rule_3_1s: 3₁ₛ — three consecutive points beyond the same ±1 SD limit
Qc.Rule_4_1s: 4₁ₛ — four consecutive points beyond the same ±1 SD limit

Qc.Rule_7T: 7ₜ — seven points in a continuous drift
Qc.Rule_8x: 8ₓ — eight points on the same side of the mean

Auth_AccountLockedOut: Account locked until {0} after repeated failed attempts.
Auth_SiteNotAuthorized: You are not authorised to work on this site.
Auth_PasswordTooWeak: The password must be at least {0} characters and mix letters, digits and special characters.
Auth_PasswordReused: This password has been used recently.
Auth_PasswordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Site_LegalNameRequired: The site's registered name is required in order to invoice.
Site_IceInvalid: The ICE must be exactly 15 digits.
Site_AddressRequired: The site's address and city are required on an invoice.
Site_MinistryAuthorizationRequired: The Ministry of Health authorisation number is required for a medical biology laboratory.
Site_ResponsibleBiologistRequired: A responsible biologist must be designated for this site.
Site_NameRequired: The French name of the site is mandatory.
Site_CodeAlreadyTaken: Site code "{0}" is already in use.
Site_CodeFrozenAfterFirstDocument: The site code can no longer be changed: it is a prefix in accession or invoice numbers already issued, and renaming it would split the series in two.
Site_CnssInvalid: The CNSS affiliation number is invalid.
Site_AccreditationNumberRequired: A site declared accredited must carry its accreditation number.
Site_ResponsibleMustBeBiologist: The responsible biologist must be a medical or pharmacist biologist registered with the Ordre (loi no. 12-01).
Sequence_FormatMustContainSeq: The format must contain the {SEQ} or {SEQ:n} token, otherwise every document would carry the same number.
Sequence_FormatFrozenAfterFirstUse: The format can no longer be changed: {0} number(s) have already been allocated and the series must stay consistent.
Sequence_CloseReasonRequired: Closing or reopening a series must be justified.
Sequence_AlreadyInThatState: The series is already in that state.
Equipment_NameRequired: The French name of the equipment is mandatory.
Equipment_CodeAlreadyTaken: Equipment code "{0}" is already in use.
Equipment_AnalyserNeedsCalibrationInterv: An analyser requires a calibration interval: without one, the control forbidding a patient result on a lapsed calibration can never fire.
Equipment_MaintenanceIntervalInvalid: The maintenance interval must be between 1 and 3650 days.
Equipment_CalibrationIntervalInvalid: The calibration interval must be between 1 and 3650 days.
Equipment_VerificationIntervalInvalid: The verification interval must be between 1 and 3650 days.
QcMaterial_LotRequired: The control material's lot number is mandatory.
QcMaterial_NameRequired: The French name of the material is mandatory.
QcMaterial_AlreadyExpired: The expiry date entered ({0}) has already passed.
QcMaterial_OpenedInFuture: The opening date cannot be later than today.
QcMaterial_LotLevelAlreadyExists: Lot {0} at level {1} already exists: one control set carries the same lot across several levels, and each is a separate material.
QcTarget_AlreadyDefined: A target already exists for this material, parameter and instrument.
QcTarget_SdMustBePositive: The standard deviation must be strictly positive.
QcTarget_MeanRequiredWithSd: An SD without a mean allows no calculation: enter both.
QcTarget_CvOutOfRange: The maximum CV must be between 0 and 100 %.
QcTarget_AtLeastOneRuleRequired: At least one Westgard rule must be active: a target with no rule records points and never rejects a run.
Stock_NameRequired: The French name of the item is mandatory.
Stock_UnitRequired: The unit of measure is mandatory.
Stock_CodeAlreadyTaken: Item code "{0}" is already in use on this site.
Stock_ReorderBelowMinimum: The reorder point cannot be below the safety stock: the alert would fire when the laboratory is already under its target level.
Stock_MaximumBelowReorder: The maximum stock cannot be below the reorder point.
Stock_HazardClassRequired: A product declared hazardous must carry its hazard class.
Supplier_CodeAlreadyTaken: Supplier code "{0}" is already in use.
